blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Embassy in Paris has urged Filipinos living in France to prepare 72-hour emergency kits and take precautions amid recurring protests in the country. In an advisory issued on Monday evening (Manila time), the embassy said French authorities had called on the public to prepare emergency supplies as part of the government’s regular efforts to strengthen national resilience and readiness for possible crises. The embassy also advised Filipinos to keep their passports, residence permits and other important documents accessible.
